verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an official Node.js SDK (@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk, currently in beta) that wraps its GraphQL API in typed methods, plus other PCI-compliant SDKs for embedding card data/checkout, indicating first-party SDK support for building against the platform. However, evidence is limited to one language SDK in beta status with no independent corroboration, no evidence of broader multi-language SDK coverage, and no OpenAPI spec available (probe found 404s). Missing for 10: multi-language/official SDK coverage beyond one beta Node.js package, independent/hands-on validation of SDK reliability, and a stable (non-beta) release status.
